On August 2, 2016, Bitfinex suffered a security breach on Bitcoin resulting in the theft of 119,755 BTC (roughly $72 million at the time). Attackers exploited a flaw in multisignature wallet key management, but exact technical details remain based on secondary sources, as the full post-incident report and code are not public. Attackers were able to access enough multisignature wallet keys to initiate mass unauthorized withdrawals. Secondary reporting indicates this was likely due to a key management flaw that stored two required signing keys on the same system, bypassing intended multi-party controls. This technical mechanism is not officially confirmed by Bitfinex or BitGo.
